techniques.label: parallel-b-standard-43-techniques
techniques.observations: All216 production-color frames actually inspected in six native paired sheets: nine equipped techniques, front/side, twelve times each. Lightning strike/pulse/breaker, fire pulse, undertow, mend, purify, aegis and signature preserve the beak, white cheeks/throat, wings, legs and tail through motion and recovery. Side capture shows the opposite side to the raw head sheets.

limits: Local exact-hash review, no live delivery or authenticated modal claim. Feather layers and closed beak naturally occlude internal mouth surfaces; visible lower beak and white chin/throat silhouette inspected in production lighting without observed tearing. One fresh216-frame battle companion technique capture, not source override or an independent second timing capture. Original component provenance retained exactly.
